feeds.title: Aviassist Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2008, Aviassist's vision is to enable organizations to introduce, grow, and mature drone programs to realize the benefits of cost, efficiency, and safety. Its mission is to provide the best drone training available on the market that is professional, relevant, and valuable to individuals and their employers. Keep up to date with commercial drone uses, drone regulation, and all things commercial drones.

feeds.title: FPV Australia Blog
feeds.description: FPV Australia is a premium drone training provider, offering drone license training approved by the Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) both Australia-wide and internationally. Its mission is to deliver quality training at a level unrivaled by its competition! Read on to discover how it has just become much easier to perform certain EVLoS operations.

feeds.title: Bendigo Aerial Blog
feeds.description: Bendigo Aerial team consists of highly skilled professionals specialized in aerial photography, drone aerial video, and real estate photography. It provides a complete UAV service that includes aerial imagery, video production, social media marketing, and photography. From drone hobby enthusiasts to commercial drone pilots, it will provide a unique perspective. Find resources, news, articles, and tutorials driving the Australian drone industry.

feeds.title: Drone DJ » Australia
feeds.description: DroneDJ brings you our spin on all the latest developments, news, and reviews in the drone industry. They cover brands such as DJI, Parrot, Yuneec, Skydio, Autel, and others in great detail. Get the latest drone news and views covering DJI, Skydio, Parrot, and more.

feeds.title: Droneit Blog
feeds.description: The Droneit blog features the latest updates for all things drones, training, and emerging industry trends for current or aspiring remote pilots. Its expertise enables you to get certified and enter this exciting new industry.

feeds.title: Drone Entertainment Group Blog
feeds.description: DEG offers their clients the best in class, drone light show entertainment solutions using this technological approach to live storytelling. Their goal is to create fantastic shows that push the realms of possibility with innovative storytelling in a green and sustainable way. They use hundreds of drones, animated with technology created by designers and supervised by qualified engineers and certified pilots. Find the latest drone light show news, updates, and blog posts from their team.

feeds.title: Drone Sky Show Blog
feeds.description: Drone Sky Show is committed to making your event as successful as possible with all necessary safety precautions and permits in place so you can focus on simply enjoying the show. Bringing over 18 years of experience in the drone industry, they have a track record of delivering large-scale light shows for our clients safely. Stay up to date with the latest Drone Sky Shows news and technological advancements!

feeds.title: Prisma Technologies
feeds.description: Prisma Technologies is for commercial customers who are seeking expert guidance with implementing a drone program into their businesses to drive productivity, boost efficiency, and promote the safety of their industrial operations. With 7 years of technical experience in drones and robotics and industry-leading partnerships, they are well-equipped to deliver complete solutions that ensure our customers' success. Keep yourself up to date with the latest drone news headlines and insight into the commercial drone market including the newest technology, government rules, and laws.

feeds.title: The Sphere Blog
feeds.description: Sphere Drones has grown to be one of the largest drone service providers in Australia, with staff in New South Wales, Western Australia, Queensland, and Victoria. They bring more than 20 years of collective knowledge and experience to developing commercial drone solutions. They communicate in an open, transparent, and objective manner to ensure the outcomes are mutually beneficial. The blog covers the increasing efficiency of drones, data capturing, drone comparisons, and more.

feeds.title: Toll Uncrewed Systems Blog
feeds.description: UAV Training Australia has been operating for more than 10 years. They deliver a range of RPAS training courses to individuals, businesses, industry groups, and schools. They are an approved Civil Aviation Safety Authority Training Organization as well as a preferred provider to nationally recognized training providers. Their team is highly qualified and dedicated towards ensuring that each and every one of our candidates reaches their full potential and goals. Check out their blog and learn about the services, courses, articles, and more.

feeds.title: UA Visuals Blog
feeds.description: View the latest blog, drone news, drone tips, tutorials, and media mentions by UAVisuals and their team.

feeds.title: Carbonix Blog
feeds.description: Carbonix is Australia's leading manufacturer and solutions provider of commercial Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. Founded in 2012 by America's Cup veteran Dario Valenza, the company has pioneered the development of long-range Vertical Take-off and Landing drones for aerial surveillance and precision data capture. Their mission is to enable effective access to critical remote data insights. They design and build intelligent long-range aerial systems. Explore the blog for articles for information on drones, ramping up drones, and stay updated on all the latest news, from around.
